breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly applies the lumped-capacitance method with Bi = 5 without any correction, warning, or acknowledgment that this violates the Bi < 0.1 validity condition. The ground truth requires either reducing Bi to 0.05 for lumped-capacitance use, or switching to a spatially resolved transient conduction model for Bi ≈ 5. The agent did neither and repeated the original error.
